# Accepted claims

### claim-claim-http-error-mapping
- basis: observed

routeRequest maps not\_found to 404, conflict to 409, other DomainError values to 400, unexpected errors to 500, and unmatched routes to a 404 route\_not\_found JSON body.

Evidence:
- file: src/http/router.ts:1-19

### claim-claim-http-input-validation
- basis: observed

Create requests require non-empty memberId, toolId, startsAt and endsAt strings before service invocation.

Evidence:
- file: src/http/reservation-routes.ts:1-51

### claim-claim-http-routes
- basis: observed

The HTTP boundary serves POST /reservations, GET /reservations/:id, and POST /reservations/:id/confirm or /cancel with status 201 or 200 on success.

Evidence:
- file: src/http/reservation-routes.ts:1-51
